name: The Saudi Investment Bank
summary: The Saudi Investment Bank provides commercial and retail banking services to individuals, small to medium-sized businesses, and corporate and institutional customers in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company operates through Retail Banking, Corporate Banking, Treasury and Investments, and Asset Management and Brokerage and other segments. The company offers loans, deposits, and other products for public institutions, high-net worth individuals and consumers; money market, investments and treasury services, and investments in associates and related activities.
